cohort: A total of 71 females who underwent bariatric surgery were studied, including those with PCOD symptoms, primary infertility, and those who conceived post-surgery.
finding: Bariatric surgery significantly improves menstrual abnormalities associated with PCOD and fertility, along with influencing maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Among patients who conceived after bariatric surgery, 73.4% had normal vaginal deliveries.
